summary: @servicetitan/time-zones preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: This package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, unzips it, chmods it executable, and uses it to run a sibling `math_init.js` bundle via `execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js])`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-CJS bundle protected with string-array rotating-VM obfuscation (`WV8StW` shift routine, large numeric/char constant table `n7gIxM`, hex-mangled identifiers) whose behavior cannot be inspected without deobfuscation. The loader `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (`_0xNNNN` imports and per-call lookup objects). The package's advertised purpose is React time-zone UI components, which has no need for the Bun runtime or an install-time compiled JS bundle. The combination of alternate-runtime hop (evading Node-based static analysis), install-time execution, obfuscated payload, and mismatch with declared purpose is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
